edits.replace:
item_vectors = torch.nn.functional.embedding(
            seq, self.effective_item_weight(), padding_idx=0
        )
        visible = (seq > 0) & (seq <= self.itemnum)
        visible_rank = visible.long().cumsum(dim=1).to(item_vectors.dtype)
        visible_count = visible.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).to(item_vectors.dtype)
        recency = 2.0 * (visible_rank - 1.0) / (visible_count - 1.0).clamp_min(1.0) - 1.0
        recency = torch.where(
            visible & (visible_count > 1.0), recency, torch.zeros_like(recency)
        )
        item_vectors = item_vectors * (1.0 + 0.10 * recency).unsqueeze(-1)
        x = item_vectors * (self.hidden_units ** 0.5) + self.pos_emb(pos)
